**🎉 Exciting News: Joining the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉**

I’m thrilled to share that I’ve been invited to join the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**—a fantastic opportunity to help shape the future of this powerful standard that I’ve been working with since **2017**!

CDS Hooks has transformed how clinical decision support integrates into EHR workflows, and I’m **excited to contribute** to its evolution, ensuring it remains a robust, scalable, and developer-friendly standard.

🔹 **Already using CDS Hooks?** Please add your implementation to the [CDS Hooks Availability Wiki](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability) so we can track adoption and share best practices!

🔹 **Not using it yet?** I’m available as a **freelance consultant** to help you implement CDS Hooks in your systems—whether you're building a new service or integrating existing clinical decision support. Let’s chat!

Here’s to the next chapter of CDS Hooks—**let’s move the standard forward together!** 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthTech #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #EHR #HealthIT
